findings.testGate: The retained encrypted ZIP lifecycle case runs only when RIDE_NIRSOFT_FIXTURE_DIRECTORY is set to an existing directory. It then passes the retained nirlauncher-referred.zip and x64tools.zip paths to Install-RidePortablePayload.
findings.testCalls: The retained-archive case invokes Install-RidePortablePayload twice per selected archive after checking catalog PortableMembers and frozen inventories; it inspects the installed manifest/state but is a staging lifecycle test.
findings.tempPattern: Install-RidePortablePayload creates RIDE-Portable-<guid> under [IO.Path]::GetTempPath(). This is consistent with the reported path pattern; it cannot identify the environment temp root, the actual caller, archive revision, or process that created the report file.
findings.currentSelection: The catalog operations specify exact PortableMembers lists that omit PasswordScan in both architectures. The installer selects encrypted ZIP members before calling tar.exe for selected members only; source inspection does not prove runtime extraction behavior.

disposition: The retained encrypted-Pester test is a plausible source of a RIDE-Portable-GUID subtree if explicitly enabled, but causation is not established. Do not repeat it or inspect the reported file. Keep both PasswordScan architectures excluded and affected staging/Pester reruns paused until actual run configuration and catalog/source revision can be established safely.

resolved: Static source trace identifies the conditional retained-archive Pester test and the generic RIDE-Portable-GUID staging path.
partial: The trace establishes a possible mechanism only; it does not establish the creator or exact revision.
excluded: PasswordScan x86 and x64 remain excluded.
